en: Monochrome postcard showing a seated statue of a bearded man on a high pedestal surrounded by wreaths. The figure is in formal 19th‑century dress, sitting in an armchair; on the pedestal the name "HAMERLING." is clearly inscribed. The statue appears to stand in an outdoor setting framed by two architectural posts. There is cursive handwriting along the bottom margin and faint writing along the left edge.
